'''Kaya Natari''' was an employee of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. The corporation sent Natari to investigate the possibility of using "Archaeological site 75-D", Czerka's name for the abandoned [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]], for future Czerka Corporation endeavors. Upon entering the ruins, Natari was immediately attacked by beasts, but Natari's security team, endorsed by [[Keldran]], was able to deal with the creatures. In a field journal, Natari recorded that the old site was of no use for Czerka, either monetary or martial.<ref name="Codex" />

==Biography==
Kaya trained in the [[Institute of Cultural Studies]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], and was even nominated for [[Aryss Medal of Outstanding Scholarly Contribution]] for her study of the ancient [[Beast Riders]]' offensives against the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. However, she was rejected from further consideration when the judgment committee discovered she had used unapproved and intrusive field methods for data collection. Despite this setback, Natari graduated with distinction and began postdoctoral work on [[Ziost]]. She became embroiled in further scandal when samples from her project were found among items in a black market auction on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Hutta]].<ref name="LOTS Codex" />

Later in her career Natari has accepted contracts with the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], [[Drakon Industries]], and [[Czerka Interstellar]].<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3626 BBY]], [[Czerka Interstellar|Czerka]] sent Natari to investigate the possibility of using "Archaeological site 75-D", Czerka's name for the abandoned [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]], for future Czerka Corporation endeavors. Upon entering the ruins, Natari was immediately attacked by beasts, but Natari's security team, endorsed by [[Keldran]], was able to deal with the creatures. In a field journal, Natari recorded that the old site was of no use for Czerka, either monetary or martial.<ref name="LOTS Codex" />

Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> Natari and a team of mercenaries were tasked with stealing a relic documenting the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] involvement in [[Voss (species)|Voss]] culture from the [[Shrine of Contemplation]] on [[Voss]]. She was [[Czerka invasion of Voss|stopped]] by a member of the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]] and did not succeed.<ref name="OW">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Old Wounds|[[Voss]]}}</ref>
